Why.text: The provider drops about one webhook in two hundred, and a dropped one leaves the order unpaid in our records.

For what.text: Data integrity: every paid order is recorded as paid.

When.text: Before the November sales campaign starts.

How.text: Store the webhook id and skip an id that was already applied; retry three times with backoff.

How far.text: Only the payment webhook handler; no change to refunds. Undo by reverting the commit.
